_comment: Deterministic filters. Edit this file, not the code. Every value here runs before any model call, so tightening these is the cheapest way to improve the digest.
_titles: Drafted from Shivani's actual resume (Marketing Program Manager at AWS, Vendor Manager at Amazon, GTM/marketing-ops background) — this is a starting cluster, not a final answer. Adjust freely; a posting must match one of these to survive stage 6.
_salaryFloor: TODO Irtiza: the compensation floor as a plain number, e.g. 120000. A posting that states no salary is NEVER rejected by this — it passes, flagged as unknown, and the scorer is told.
_metros: Remote-only is the hard gate, per the interview. Adding a metro here re-admits onsite and hybrid roles in that place.
_usRemoteOnly: Set per Irtiza's follow-up: US-remote, not remote-anywhere. Rejects a posting that names a specific non-US country/region with no US option (e.g. 'Remote - India', 'Remote - Netherlands'). A bare 'Remote' with no country stated still passes — never rejected on a guess, same rule as the salary floor.
